blockers.finding: trace_name() serializes every non-kStart TraceKind value as COMPLETE, so an invalid enum can preserve the checkpoint preimage.
blockers.evidence: Independent negative probe changed a terminal completion trace kind to static_cast<TraceKind>(99); restore accepted it without a digest update.
blockers.required_fix: Use an exhaustive kStart/kComplete switch with fail-closed default and add in-memory plus rehashed-wire invalid TraceKind tests.

claim_boundary: CPU-synthetic single-discrete-GPU timed-service, contention and checkpoint replay only; not GPU, calibration, production-scale, model, routing/residency, multi-GPU or UMA evidence.
authorized_next_stage: CPU-only correction of ARCH-P4-R2-B1 followed by a fresh run, candidate ledger and three-role same-hash review.
